# IPD Agent Workflow Framework v0.5.3-beta

Development candidate; publication requires the recorded qualification gates.

### Added

- Opt-in versioned IR/SR/AR requirements, scoped criteria, serial increments, typed trace links and change-impact plans.
- Eighteen original Markdown template types in English and Chinese, pinned by version and digest, with safe multi-instance creation and structural lint. IR/SR/AR use multi-row registers with shared HTML cells; four TR1–TR4 overall document types remain discussion drafts. Original pack versions remain resolvable.
- Requirement-aware Review manifests, independent IR/SR/AR verification, delivery snapshots and explicit historical evidence reuse.
- Read-only Dashboard requirement navigation and separate coverage dimensions.
- Stage drafts explain where analysis, individual requirement derivations and
  register consolidation occur, including calculation/diagram/rationale records
  and checks that the child set covers its parent. These remain discussion drafts.
- A public synthetic room-booking project completes both languages with 3 IRs,
  6 SRs, 12 ARs, sixteen filled documents, stage snapshots and executable evidence.
  Its first-use findings inform the 0.2.1 stage and 1.1.1 register guidance.

### Compatibility

Legacy projects keep their existing behavior. Enabling requirements requires a zero-write plan and explicit authorization. Core state remains 2.0. Projects without requirements retain Runtime 1.0; model adoption uses Runtime 1.1 and older clients reject it. The requirement registry uses its own strict 1.0 contract. Original facts are retained in a hashed migration snapshot. Installed wheel and sdist include public templates and schemas.

### Approval boundary

One active increment, one Claim and one Review subject remain. Filled templates and passing module tests never grant approval. Authorization remains an explicit caller assertion; authenticated repository approval mapping is planned separately. This candidate performs no Git/SVN writes or network synchronization.

### Known limitations

Markdown is the supported document format. Delivery snapshots have explicit size budgets; result reuse currently materializes UTF-8 evidence. Project-specific stage mappings and private template packs need explicit configuration. Structural lint does not establish content quality. See RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md for tests actually executed and remaining platform, browser and private Golden gates; unexecuted coverage is not a pass.

### 新增能力

显式启用的 IR/SR/AR、精确判据范围、串行增量、类型化追踪、变更预览；18 类中英文 Markdown 模板、版本摘要锁定、多实例安全创建及结构检查；IR/SR/AR 多条需求管理表支持共享单元格，新增四类 TR1—TR4 总体文档讨论稿并保留旧模板包；评审输入绑定、分层验证、交付快照与历史证据复用；只读需求导航及独立覆盖维度。

### 兼容性

阶段文档讨论稿补充首次编写顺序、各章目的 / 输入 / 产出，以及逐条 IR→SR、SR→AR 分解论证和组合覆盖核对，明确先分析形成需求，再整理管理表。
新增公开合成会议室预约器的中英文完整填写示例：3IR、6SR、12AR、16份文档、阶段快照与实际软件证据；填写走查补齐唯一记录编号、渐进元数据和前后阶段版本指引。

旧项目默认保持原行为。启用模型先零写入预览，再明确授权；原事实保存为带摘要的迁移快照。核心状态保留 2.0；启用需求模型后 Runtime 使用 1.1，旧工具拒绝写入；需求登记使用独立严格契约。安装包包含公共模板及 Schema。

### 审批边界

保持每项目一个活动增量、一个 Claim、一个 Review Subject。模板填写、模块通过和生成矩阵均不等于人类批准。授权仍采用显式声明，可信平台审批映射另行实现。本候选版本不执行 Git/SVN 写入或同步。

### 已知限制

当前支持 Markdown，快照有大小预算，证据复用支持 UTF-8 文本。项目阶段映射及私有模板需显式配置，结构检查不证明内容质量。实际验证及待执行的平台、浏览器与私有 Golden 门以 RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md 为准。


### Increment audit and QA template publication / 增量审计与 QA 模板发布

New model-enabled events explicitly bind the increment, base delivery baseline and scope digest. Immutable template draft, independent human review and authorized publication records are required even for built-in packs before managed document creation. Controlled single-Owner conversion creates replacement files and preserves prior instances. Two complete synthetic delivery cycles are exercised in both languages; all simulated human decisions remain test declarations.

启用模型后的新事件明确绑定增量、基础交付基线及范围摘要。内置包与私有包均须先完成不可变草稿、独立人工评审和授权发布记录，才能新建受管文档。单 Owner 受控转换生成新文件并保留旧实例。双语合成测试覆盖两轮完整交付；模拟人类决定不等于真实 QA 验收。
